body: Thanks for the report. We'll look into it however it is unlikely the fix will be backported all the way to the 6.5.x line.
That's fine, thanks. I have my eyes set on 6.7 and the support for combining `group by` and `order by`!

issue.title: SQL: Fix issue with IN not resolving to underlying keyword field

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
- Add resolution to the exact keyword field (if exists) for text fields.
- Add proper verification and error message if underlying keyword
doesn't exist.
- Move check for field attribute in the comparison list to the
`resolveType()` method of `IN`.

Fixes: #38424
